directories.execution: Runtime adapters contain process/transport failures so owned execution resources can be cleaned up and reported.
directories.kernel: Kernel loops convert boundary failures into durable task outcomes; broad catches preserve completion truth.
directories.policy: Credential/policy parsing rejects malformed optional input without breaking policy evaluation.
directories.reality: Verification/reality boundaries fail closed and retain evidence instead of allowing an unverified mutation.
directories.scheduler: Scheduler loop failures are isolated per trigger and surfaced as durable degraded/retry state.
directories.state: Durability/recovery boundaries must retain truthful terminal evidence.
